series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_qc_note: All ten frames passed visual review, are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs, are uploaded to Drive folder 1wAKHTfOOyFxJSW0KL9_ma1pn2sJO283F, and each Drive MD5 matches its local file; Drive lists exactly ten images. Seven passed on the first pass. IMG0285 arrived with 12 px letterbox bars and was reframed to full-bleed, then needed three attempts for silhouette and hair colour — a flared modern coat with a fur stole, then a correct silhouette in honey-blonde hair against the ash-white lock. IMG0286 needed one rerender to stop the basalt columns reading as coursed, quarried masonry. IMG0290 needed two rerenders on hair alone: heavy chest braids, then a fishtail braid along the scalp, before plain loose hair. The batch is deliberately the emptiest of the episode — no writing, carving, tally, rune or token appears in any frame, because the narration is about the failure of the record. Continuity flags: no clothing darker than charcoal; no hewn or coursed stone in the caldera; the young herdsman's face in IMG0288 reads sharper and more filmic than in IMG0283 and must not drift into a heroic lead; and heavy braiding must be negated explicitly, since simply asking for loose hair produced a scalp braid twice.

scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Sheep sharp in the foreground, green pasture ending hard against black volcanic ground and a smoking cone; the seated herdsman is in clean side profile and the line between grass and rock carries the covenant beat. Continuity flag: this face reads markedly more angular and filmic than IMG0283 — the same young man must not drift further toward a heroic lead in Batch 030.

scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Ultra-wide terraced foothills, three cones, Summer Sea band, tiny basalt fold. No field grid, no roads, no white farm buildings, no fence lines.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — Missing sheep lure young herdsmen up toward sulfur vents
scenes.qc_note: Approved on the second rerender. Pass 1 grew heavy chest braids; pass 2 replaced them with a fishtail braid worked along the scalp; pass 3 is plain loose hair with no plaiting at all. The fissure under his palm emits white steam only, no molten glow, and his face stays bowed into shadow.
